Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_BulletMold: A reusable ceramic mold for pistol and rifle projectile batches.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_FactoryPrimer: A dependable factory component. Rarely found in ammunition storage.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_HeavyCasing: A formed casing for .45 Auto and .44 Magnum ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_HeavyProjectile: A cast projectile for .45 Auto and .44 Magnum ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_ImprovisedPrimer: A high-skill, renewable ignition component for field-made ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_MineralSalts: An abstracted, non-real-world feedstock used for propellant and primers.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_Propellant: A renewable, ammunition-only propellant that does not substitute for explosive-grade gunpowder.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_RifleCasing: A formed casing for vanilla rifle ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_RifleProjectile: A cast projectile for vanilla rifle ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_ShotCharge: A prepared shot charge for one shotgun shell.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_ShotgunHull: A formed hull and metal base for one shotgun shell.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_ShotgunMold: A reusable ceramic mold based on an unused Build 42 shotgun-shell asset.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_SmallCasing: A formed casing for 9mm, .38 Special, and .357 Magnum ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_SmallProjectile: A cast projectile for 9mm, .38 Special, and .357 Magnum ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_UnfiredMold: Fire this fragile clay mold in a Kiln before use.
